text:
The matter has been reviewed by the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, and we appreciate the chance to address your concern.

You wrote to say that your complaint about the handling of your companion animal during travel was not met with the care, clarity, or follow-up you expected from Aurelia Skyways. We understand how upsetting that can be, especially when a pet's comfort and safe arrival are involved. Our records show that a welcome team is meant to prepare passengers carefully before boarding and that supervisors are expected to listen closely when a traveler is worried. We regret that your experience did not reflect that standard.

<<FACT F120>> We have placed your report in the active file and shared it with the relevant supervisor for review. The complaint will be checked against the boarding notes, handling records, and any staff comments connected with the journey. If additional detail is needed, we will seek it through the usual service channel so the review can be completed properly.

At the same time, we want to acknowledge the distress that may follow an incident involving a companion animal, whether the concern was about reassurance, handling, or the condition in which the animal was received. Our team is expected to communicate promptly and respectfully, and we are sorry that this did not happen to your satisfaction. While we cannot change what has already taken place, we can confirm that the concern has been noted, reviewed for process issues, and forwarded for further attention where appropriate.

If you continue to need support, please keep all related travel notes and any service correspondence together so the file remains complete. We also encourage you to use the standard contact path for any follow-up so the matter can be handled without delay or confusion. Clear, calm communication helps us respond in the most useful way.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention and for giving us the chance to review it carefully. We will continue to treat companion animal concerns with care and respect.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
